caption: The drawing depicts a bird-shaped object positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The bird appears to be constructed from coiled, circular segments in various shades of brown, forming its body, head, and base. Its beak is small and straight, colored in a matching brown. The bird has a purple area on its body resembling a wing. It is perched on a short cylindrical pedestal that connects to a round base. The rim of the base is adorned with small, evenly spaced blue and red circular decorations. The paper shows signs of aging with some faint discoloration, and the name "Charles Garjian" is lightly written in cursive in the lower right corner.
title: Pa. German Toy Bird
